The_Justifier:

Given that I have hundreds of games in the app across the past 20ish months, which are not part of the statistics unless they’re being harvested automatically from the app without my input,

Yes, they are, anonymously. I have an ID code which neither Handelabra nor I have any way of matching to you. This is how Unity Analytics (and pretty much every other analytics package) works.

Powerhound_2000:

As far as villains go the stats using the model number have Dreamer as the most difficult without using advance, challenge, or ultimate rules. Cosmic Omnitron is the harder once Challenge and Ultimate rules are used.

It’s interesting, since I don’t think most people would peg Dreamer as hardest. I have a feeling it’s a combination of: 1) Most digital players play at Ⓗ=5 because they can, but that makes her much, much harder, 2) It’s really easy to play too quickly in digital, not pay attention, and accidentally kill her, and 3) Once she’s dead, you can’t undo.

Progeny might be biased because so many people played him to get the F5 unlocks and really mastered how to cheese him. But he’s also really not that hard for a 4. Matriarch… I don’t know why she’d be considered one of the hardest, honestly.

If you do count Challenge Modes, COT is a much more respectable case for being the hardest, because he has a really insane and unbalanced challenge effect, though on Ultimate I’m still inclined to think the various 4s probably beat him, along with the Ennead.

Matriarch is only really hard if she gets out both Huginn and Muninn before you can stabilize, and she’s very vulnerable to being cheesed. Legacy utterly shuts her down with Next Evolution as long as there are other Ongoings you can lose to keep it, and even a single point of DR makes her significantly easier. She’s hard if you don’t exploit any of her vulnerabilities, but her vulnerabilities are super easy to exploit, with only the exception of both Cohorts or an Indestructible one.

Progeny is usually not too hard compared to other 4s, but I’ve failed an astonishing number of times to beat the old Weekly challenge with CM Progeny in Rook City. Maybe that’s just because Dark Watch is kind of a crap team, but Progeny with bonus card plays and damage bonuses from the Environment is pretty devastating, though he’s not nearly as bad without those advantages.
Any plans to incorporate statistics for Sentinels of Earth-Prime, now that the digital edition’s released?

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
Plans? Yes. However, there are two related hurdles.

One, Unity is phasing out their old Analytics API and implementing a new one. The old one is being sunset some time this June. Two, because Handelabra knew this was happening, neither SotM 4.0 nor Earth Prime actually incorporate analytics at all. No reason to include it when it’s just going to be dead in 2 months.

This all means that Handelabra will need to implement the new analytics system, and then I need to write new code to handle it. As you know, Handelabra has a ton on their plate right now, so while this is on their to-do list, I’m unsure how high up their to-do list it is. It’s not the hardest thing to do but it’s nontrivial, and it’s not really high importance compared to, y’know, actually making games.
Huh! I did not know that. Good to know. Should I worry about the existing page… “aging out”, so to speak, now that it’s not receiving regular updates anymore?
